description: Private JavaScript and TypeScript sandbox runtime prototype for Belgie.
name: @belgie/runtime

scripts.build:native: cargo build --manifest-path ../../Cargo.toml -p belgie-node -p belgie-worker && mkdir -p native && cp ../../target/debug/libbelgie_node.dylib native/belgie_runtime_binding.node && cp ../../target/debug/belgie-runtime-worker native/belgie-runtime-worker && chmod 755 native/belgie-runtime-worker
scripts.test: npm run build && vitest run && npm run check
